records.text: These horses are ordinary animals found across several regions.
An Overworked Nag found in Ghostlands and Grizzly Hills.
Adarrah is grateful for help after being captured. Adarrah offers a charm found before the capture, hopes it will aid the rescuer and insists that the vile beasts must be stopped.
A young frosthorn beast.
“Buckets” Cleary is a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.

Captain Gryan Stoutmantle commands the Westfall Brigade at its encampment. He describes the force as stretched between the Horde to the west and iron dwarves to the east, and seeks resources for its operations. His orders can redirect capable recruits north to Light’s Breach as the Scourge threat in Zul’Drak grows.
A rank-and-file Westfall Brigade footman stationed at the brigade’s encampment. These footmen represent the brigade’s ordinary soldiers rather than a separately named individual.

Brugar Stoneshear is an Explorers’ League surveyor at the Westfall Brigade Encampment. He withdrew his men from Thor Modan when fighting made excavation impossible, then sends help to aid the Earthen and search for tunnel entrances and the missing Surveyor Orlond. He is concerned that unstable tunnels could collapse on the brigade, and his frustration at the fruitless search comes through bluntly.
Tiernan Anvilheart is a weapon merchant who offers goods for browsing. His established role centers on selling weapons.
Sergeant Tyric is a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.
Sergeant Daelian is a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.
Private Furlbrow is a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.
Private Jansen is a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.

Kurun is a stone giant commander directing the struggle against the iron dwarves at Thor Modan. He says his forces and the Earthen are too few to win without help, and that the giants cannot use their strength in the narrow tunnels. He equips allies to rally his brothers and disrupt the iron dwarves’ attempt to reclaim the city.
These Grizzly Hills giants are Kurun’s besieging forces at Thor Modan. Kurun describes them as his brothers, fighting iron dwarves who have enthralled many of them.
A boulder target near Thor Modan, used in the effort to disrupt the iron dwarves’ work there.
Rune Reavers are hostile rune-wielding combatants in the Thor Modan area. This one casts Rune of Retribution when it enters combat.
Iron Rune-Shapers are among the iron dwarves defending Thor Modan, whom the Horde is urged to fight.
An Earthen warrior of the stone people fighting the iron dwarves’ constructs around Thor Modan. These warriors attack when encountered and are part of the battle over the city.

A runic battle golem, one of the iron dwarves’ constructs fighting the Earthen around Thor Modan. It attacks with battle runes, and the Westfall Brigade has asked for help defeating these golems so the Earthen can gain ground.

Forgemaster Damrath leads the iron defenders at Thor Modan. He rallies his constructs to defend the capital, urges his iron brethren to crush the stone people, and calls for loyalty to the thane and Loken. His battle cries place him firmly with the iron dwarves’ resistance.

A mortally wounded Earthen warrior at Thor Modan, its stone body cracked and gouged. It begs the player to find Kurun, whom it identifies as the leader commanding the Earthen on the hill, and reports that they cannot take the city.
A runic war golem serving among the iron dwarves’ defenders at Thor Modan. It fights with a rune punch against the Earthen.

Iron Thane Argrum is the dwarf commanding the resistance inside Thor Modan. Kurun describes the Earthen as bravely fighting the city’s constructs, but says they cannot break in; he asks for Argrum to be killed to overcome the defenders. Argrum fights with lightning magic.
Redfang Hunters are hunters found across Grizzly Hills. When out of combat, they hold their ground.
Frostpaw Warriors are warriors found across Grizzly Hills. They use Rend in combat, fitting the direct martial role named for them.

Torthen Deepdig is an Explorers' League member at Westfall Brigade Encampment who handles Brann Bronzebeard's journal and the runic plates. On hearing the plates' contents, he connects them to a possible new titan city and urges the League to follow Brann, showing his urgency about the expedition's discoveries.
An Explorers' League surveyor is stationed at Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills, supporting the League's field work there.
Tallhorn Stags are widespread wildlife across Grizzly Hills, appearing in many of its areas.
Entropic Oozes are slime creatures encountered across Grizzly Hills. In combat they use Crude Ooze, giving them a direct combat role among the region's creatures.
Imperial Eagles soar through Grizzly Hills. Local investigators found that the Horde was binding its sight to these birds to spy on the camp; in combat, an eagle can swoop at its attacker.

Squire Walter serves Gryan's Westfall Brigade, where he has squire duties. Emily identifies him as her brother, and Walter's response to her return with Mr. Floppy expresses relief that they are safe. His camp service is closely tied to his concern for his family.
Maevin Farmoon is the Westfall Brigade Encampment's Trade Goods vendor. Visitors can browse the goods he offers.

Quartermaster McCarty is an innkeeper. He welcomes visitors and offers a place to rest; his inn also offers making it a home and buying goods. His greeting presents these services as camp hospitality.

Squire Percy is a Stable Master at the Westfall Brigade Encampment. He says he and Squire Walter care for Old Blanchy and the other mounts. Percy recruits help to capture Highland Mustangs, hoping the horses will please Captain Stoutmantle.
Balfour Blackblade is the Westfall Brigade Encampment's Reagents and Poisons vendor, with a trade focused on those goods.
Father Michaels is a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.
Veira Langdon serves as a general goods merchant, offering everyday supplies and ammunition to anyone who comes to browse her goods.

Sasha's Hunt describes the Solstice Hunters as victims of a curse that turns people into beasts, and frames killing them as mercy because they are too far gone. Sasha also says the people of Silverbrook and Solstice Village listened to the wolfcult.
Private Molsen, a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.

Iron Thane Furyhammer is Dun Argol's leader and oversees production there. Briefings from Raegar Breakbrow and Tormak the Scarred say his personal construct, the Anvil, shields him; disrupting it removes that protection.
Known as Furyhammer's Guardian, the figure called The Anvil is a hostile combatant that answers combat with a Molten Blast.
Lightning Sentries are hostile sentry creatures. In combat, they cast a Charged Sentry Totem.
The Iron Rune-Smith is a hostile rune-smith who uses Lightning Charged and Smelt Rune in combat.
Rune-Smith Durar is one of the rune-smiths who manufactures a power cell for the war golem. His workshop is on Dun Argol's central level; in combat, he uses Lightning Charged.
Rune-Smith Kathorn is one of the rune-smiths who manufactures a power cell for the war golem. His workshop is on Dun Argol's central level.
A Runic Lightning Gunner is a runic gunner encountered in the Grizzly Hills. It holds its ground outside combat.
A Wolfcult Initiate is a humanoid figure found in the Grizzly Hills.
Runed Giants are large, runed combatants found across several parts of the Grizzly Hills. One calls on the children of iron and iron masters for aid, and urges them to attack a smaller foe.
Longhoof Grazers are beasts found in several parts of the Grizzly Hills. They use a head butt when fighting.

Gavrock is a stone giant at the Ruins of Tethys who seeks to free his bound brothers from the iron dwarves. He identifies Loken as their commander and says Loken directs the war against the stone giants, including plans to exterminate them. Gavrock offers a shard from his own substance to help release the giants, and presses on despite the risk that it may fail.

Budd presents himself as a troll and is prompted as a playmate for an encounter with ice trolls. He sometimes holds very still and pretends not to hear, rocks on his haunches while muttering in troll speech, or asks visitors to leave so he can rest. When he does answer, he speaks in troll dialect, boasts of troll power, and reacts irritably to being treated as a curiosity.

Drakuru is a troll held in a cage at Granite Springs, where he proposes a temporary truce with the visitor despite recalling that he has killed many people by shrinking their heads. He says he was captured while interpreting hieroglyphs in pursuit of a legendary artifact said to have made Drak'Tharon Keep impervious. He seeks a blood bond and an elixir to stay in contact, presenting cooperation as useful to the visitor's struggle. His dialogue shows practical knowledge of local ingredients and the Drakkari, while his request to use their frozen mojo for his research acknowledges the cost to his own people and calls it a greater good.

Samir is a humanoid at Granite Springs who is involved in the camp’s live ice troll bounty. The camp uses Budd to mingle with local trolls and capture them for sale, and Samir directs hunters toward this work.
A Drakkari warrior encountered in the region, this humanoid uses a combat spell when its health changes.
A Frostpaw shaman, this humanoid has a shamanic role among the local wildlife and stands its ground outside combat.
The Redfang Elder is a humanoid spellcaster who uses Hurricane in combat and casts Chain Heal on a friendly target when badly hurt, giving it a supporting role alongside its attacks.
An ice serpent found in the region, this animal uses Ice Slash at close range.
A Drakkari shaman encountered in the region, this humanoid uses a combat spell during combat.
A diseased Drakkari encountered in the Northrend region. Its fevered disease makes it a threat in combat.
A Drakkari plaguebringer among the Scourge encountered in Northrend. This veteran foe carries the plaguebringer role into combat.
A Scourge corpserender encountered in Northrend, with sightings in two local areas.
Highland Mustangs are a horse population found across several areas of the Grizzly Hills. When hit by a spell, the creature casts a spell at the caster.
Ameenah is a reagent vendor in the Grizzly Hills. Her nameplate identifies her specialty, and visitors can browse her goods.

Hugh Glass is a merchant at the Redwood Trading Post who knows about Loken and the Iron Dwarves. He is wary of Limpy Joe’s killer and deeply concerned for his pet Griselda, whose picky appetite leaves him trying to find food she will eat.
Griselda is Hugh Glass’s pet at the Redwood Trading Post. She is a picky eater who favors fish from the Eastwind Shore, and Hugh worries about keeping her fed.
Drakuru’s Bunny 01 casts Script Cast Summon Image of Drakuru when hit by Summon Drakuru's Image.

Drakuru speaks through a summoned image, asking for help recovering artifacts tied to Drak'Tharon Keep's defenses. He promises that the keep will be cleansed of the undead and restored to its sacred purpose, and says the ritual will bring his soul peace. His plans require costly mojo from Drakkari, including his former allies, whose deaths he says he regrets but accepts as necessary.

Surveyor Orlond was an Explorers' League surveyor sent to assess the stability of Thor Modan's tunnels for an army's passage. He completed nearly all his readings before the battle forced the expedition to withdraw. Orlond was trapped, took refuge in the water, and was attacked by subterranean threshers; he died, leaving his notes and unfinished final reading behind.

Prigmon is a troll at Granite Springs who handles the dead from the surrounding ruins. The work weighs on him: wrapping the unfortunate trolls hurts his heart and his back, and he worries they may rise again if left unburned. He recruits help with the grim chores and with gathering ingredients for a friend's stew, speaking casually even as he describes the difficult work.

Subterranean threshers are dangerous creatures of Thor Modan's tunnels. Orlond's survey account says they attacked him when he sought refuge in the water, and reports that they may have taken his portable seismograph.
An image through which Drakuru addresses others using the Eye of the Prophets. He directs visitors to recover artifacts and speaks of bringing hope to his people.
Warlord Zim'bo fights to reclaim Drak'Tharon and calls for the Scourge's destruction. He says one of his own betrayed him and vows to slay the betrayer; he also speaks of capturing essence.
A famished Scourge troll encountered around Drak'Tharon. It is a target in the Burninate task.
A Drakkari shaman frightened by the fall of Drak'Tharon and the Scourge surrounding the area. His cries reflect panic and isolation: he says every troll is on their own.

Sage Paluna is a mystic at Camp Oneqwah who helps investigate Brann Bronzebeard’s journal and the iron dwarf rune plates. She prepares incense from spiritsbreath to seek ancestral wisdom, then recognizes that Brann may have found a titan city and asks the chieftain to send longrunners toward the Storm Peaks, relying on her people’s knowledge of the land to track him.

Emily is a young girl traveling with her pet rabbit, Mr. Floppy, and her brother Walter, a squire with the Westfall Brigade. After she and Mr. Floppy get lost in the woods and take shelter from wolves at a tower, she is frightened and urgently protective of him when wolves attack. She asks passersby for help finding the soldiers’ camp and is wary when someone scares her rabbit.
Mr. Floppy is Emily’s pet rabbit. He accompanies her on a walk in the woods, where the two become lost and shelter from wolves at a tower; Emily is especially concerned when wolves threaten him.
One of the graymist worgs competing with hunters for food around Amberpine Lodge; Anderhol asks for these animals to be culled as the lodge's food crisis worsens.

Mack Fearsen is a drunken troll hunter at Granite Springs who supplies grog for burning Scourge trolls. He calls Kurzel a longtime comrade but criticizes her impatience; too drunk to follow, he fears she's dead, then turns his grief into a song.
An Ursus mauler found in Grizzly Hills, it uses Maul against nearby opponents.
A saronite horror found in Grizzly Hills, it uses Seething Evil once combat begins.

Scout Vor'takh is a Horde scout at Camp Onequah whose work is tied to the conflict in Grizzly Hills. He directs attacks on the iron dwarves and seeks information about Loken and the dwarves' plans. His replies show a calculating, hard-edged officer: he weighs a captive's usefulness, threatens Tormak, and looks for ways to exploit rivalries among the forces opposing the Horde.

Silverbrook Trappers are hostile inhabitants of Silverbrook in the Grizzly Hills, found among the settlement's villagers. Captain Derrick's orders identify them as a threat alongside the villagers during the violence at Silverbrook.

Aiyan Coldwind is the innkeeper at Camp Onequah. Aiyan warmly welcomes visitors with a greeting that compares their arrival to wind crossing the plains, and the inn offers a place to make one's home as well as goods for sale.

Grumbald One-Eye is a Redfang furbolg shaman devoted to Ursoc. He is associated with Spiritsbreath, an herb used by experienced mystics in incense for seeking ancestral wisdom; he should carry it for his devotions. In combat, he uses frostfire, fire and frost magic, and can call on Elemental Enlightenment.

This is Drakuru appearing through a summoned image. He wants the Drakkari Tablets and sacred mojo so he can read the tablets, and later watches the player through the Eye of the Prophets. He directs the player to summon him at a brazier with the Heart of the Ancients and desperate mojo, saying he intends to avenge his brothers by cleansing Drak'Tharon and claim its greatest treasure.
A Drakkari defender encountered among the ruins and passage, this humanoid fights with a cleave attack.
An infected grizzly bear found around the ruins and passage. It fights by biting and can spread its infection.
Litoko Icetotem is an armor merchant in the Grizzly Hills. Visitors can browse his goods through the merchant options.
Silverbrook Villagers are hostile combatants. Their native combat actions include Chop and, when wounded, Worgen Transform.
A Directional Rune in Grizzly Hills.

Image of Drakuru is Drakuru’s summoned image, promising to cleanse Drak’Tharon Keep. Drakuru asks for the tablets and sacred mojo needed to summon him at Drakil’jin, then describes the cleansing ritual and promised treasure.
Drakkari Oracles are trolls found around Drakil’jin. Harkor names them among the trolls he wants killed.
A Drakkari troll protector found around the Drakil'jin Ruins, it meets intruders with Head Trauma.
A guardian serpent found in Drakil'jin's area, it lashes nearby foes with its tail.
An ancient Drakkari fighter who threatens to take an opponent's heart, this warmonger sounds weary beneath the aggression: he longs for endless sleep and, when defeated, says he can finally rest.
An ancient Drakkari soothsayer who shares the warmonger's heart-taking threat and weary words about sleep and rest, it also answers Blow Snow by casting Cold Cleanse.

Held captive in the Drakil'jin Ruins, Harrison Jones is preparing to break out when he asks a nearby visitor to follow. He can handle himself in a fight, but asks the visitor to watch his back; along the way he speaks of the ceremonial chamber where he was to be sacrificed, frees a woman, and reacts dryly when a trick fails.
An Iron Rune-Weaver tends a directional rune, channeling its associated spell before using Rune Weaving against a foe. Its work marks it as a runecrafter.
Envoy Ducal is the envoy sent to Silverbrook to negotiate with the trappers. His last letter reported little progress, and he was sent help with those diplomatic efforts.
The Conquest Hold Legionnaire fights with Demoralizing Shout and uses Hamstring against nearby targets.
Kragh is a Wind Rider Master at Conquest Hold. He offers flight travel; when attacked, he shouts for guards and summons an Enraged Wyvern.
Makki Wintergale is a Wind Rider Master who handles flight travel.
East Stone is one of the ancient stone markers Gavrock describes. The markers stand at places of power where a shard can be charged to help free the bound giants.
North Stone is one of the ancient stone markers Gavrock describes. The markers stand at places of power where a shard can be charged to help free the bound giants.

Conqueror Krenna demands unquestioning obedience and says respect must be earned, regardless of past accomplishments. At Conquest Hold she is determined to crush the Alliance in the Grizzly Hills rather than surrender its resources or strategic ground, ordering attacks on trappers who might join them. She despises uncertainty, orders Anthis to break the legs of a troll who has failed her, and dismissively sends a human-written journal to her sister Gorgonna.
Anthis answers a woman promptly and deferentially, addressing her as ‘my lady’ and agreeing to act at once.
Sethyel, a humanoid in Grizzly Hills.

At Conquest Hold, Provisioner Lorkran handles general goods while keeping an eye on profit. He complains that Krenna dictates what the hold buys and sells, then looks for a side business that can earn him coin and feed the grunts. His venison request serves both purposes: he wants good meat for the troops and a little extra income for himself.

Pit-Fighting Spectators are the onlookers gathered around Conquest Hold's fighting pit. They watch the fights and react with idle gestures; the group appears in several spots around the venue, making them part of the crowd rather than active participants.

Lieutenant Dumont is an Alliance officer directing work from Amberpine Lodge as the force presses through Grizzly Hills. He wants control of routes and resources, including a passage toward Zul'Drak, and treats the standoff with the Horde as a campaign requiring a decisive advantage. He pursues that advantage through negotiation, recruiting local trappers as scouts, and practical support; when Silverbrook's trappers block the road, he orders an immediate, forceful response. His priorities are military progress and keeping the initiative.
Samuel Clearbook is a gryphon master who offers flight, including a route to Light's Breach mentioned in a campaign notice for Zul'Drak. When attacked, he calls for guards.
Vana Grey is a gryphon master whose camp travel option offers fast travel. When attacked, she calls for guards.

Raegar Breakbrow is an Explorers' League researcher working against the iron dwarves' preparations for war. He organizes a plan to assemble and power a war golem from parts taken at Dun Argol, hoping to hinder the enemy and protect the Westfall Brigade. When the golem succeeds against the thane, Raegar loudly claims credit, while also praising the unlikely machine. He dislikes wasted explosives and sees them as a way to set his enemies back.

Harkor is a dwarf camping near Drakil'jin, waiting for an associate and short on food. After trolls captured him and nearly shrank his head, he remains bitter toward them and seeks revenge. He hires travelers to gather meat for his camp and to kill Drakkari near the ruins.

Mountaineer Kilian is helping Raegar's team investigate Dun Argol and the iron dwarves. With prospectors held captive and too few mountaineers to storm the settlement, he directs a rescue and plans to disguise an infiltrator as an overseer. He wants to learn the iron dwarves' plans and the history of dwarvenkind, and fears their war over Ulduar could ruin that chance.

Kraz has spent years listening for spirits and says many voices from the ruins now seek peace. He senses corruption tormenting the Drakkari dead and believes cleansing it will demand sacrifice. He asks for help recovering their belongings, obtaining Drak'aguul's mallet, and entering death to consult Gan'jo.
Undead miners appear across the local area and strike nearby targets with Puncture Wound.

Drak'aguul carries the Drakil'jin Mallet outside the ruins and commands soldiers. During a fight, he orders them to wait while he handles the attack himself, then calls for help when the opponents prove stronger than expected.

Gan'jo is a Drakkari spirit who believes prophecy foretold a visitor able to help set his people to rest. He says the spirits suffer through no fault of their own and asks the visitor to use snow from a nearby chest to quiet them. He can also guide the visitor back to the living.

Petrov is a Hollowstone miner stranded among the mine’s risen dead. Disturbed and nervous, he says the miners keep returning after he kills them, so he asks for help burning their remains with a lantern. Once they can rest, he intends to finish the job himself, insisting that Hollowstone miners never give up. He says Arugal made an example of the miners because they refused to join the wolfcult.

Sasha is hunting the wolfcult after it took her sister and her father died. She sees the cursed villagers as people turned into beasts and believes killing those too far gone is merciful. Her anger is personal and fierce: she threatens Anatoly to learn where her sister is, then seeks Arugal and his lieutenants. After her sister is safe, Sasha reassures her that no one can hurt her now.
Chaska Frosthoof is a general goods vendor in the Westfall Brigade’s Northrend region.
At Camp Oneqwah, Koro the Wanderer is identified as a Trade Goods vendor, and visitors can browse his goods.

At Camp Oneqwah, Soulok Stormfury tends the stables. He also supports the Horde effort to keep the Alliance from gaining cavalry: he asks that wild highland mustangs be driven away from Alliance handlers and approves when the task is done.
At Camp Oneqwah, Sanut Swiftspear is identified as the Reagents and Poisons vendor.

Anatoly taunts Sasha as a child and condemns her father as weak. He speaks fatalistically of everyone serving the Lich King, then pleads that Tatjana not be harmed. He reveals that a prisoner is held in a wolf den and asks whether he and Tatjana may leave.
The Shade of Arugal is a named adversary on Bloodmoon Isle. Sasha's plan places the Shade among the targets to eliminate before confronting Arugal himself.
Bloodmoon Worgen are worgen found around Bloodmoon Isle. In combat, they use an infected worgen bite.
Bloodmoon Cultists are cultists found around Bloodmoon Isle. In combat, they use an infected worgen bite.

Hidetrader Jun'ik outfits the Horde army under Conqueror Krenna and is working to a tight deadline. To stretch the supply of worg hides, he secretly substitutes grizzly hides, then asks for coal and flour to disguise them. He warns that Krenna is not known for patience and offers top price for help.
Brom Armstrong sells blacksmithing supplies in Grizzly Hills and offers equipment repair.

Jennifer Bell is an innkeeper who welcomes weary travelers and offers help. Her greeting is warm and direct; she also handles inn-related services and trade, and has a seasonal Trick or Treat interaction.
Matthew Ackerman is a stable master who helps travelers stable pets and recover lost companions. His greeting is courteous and practical, focused on those two services.
Lisa Philbrook is a Trade Goods merchant. Her role is straightforward: she offers goods for travelers to browse.
Benjamin Jacobs is a general goods merchant. He has a brief, self-conscious mutter about being “back in the bucket”.
Amberpine Footmen are foot soldiers encountered around Amberpine.
Yolanda Haymer supplies reagents.
Saffron Reynolds supplies poisons to customers who need them.

Gorgonna is Krenna's sister and a forceful voice among the trappers. She challenges Krenna's reckless choices, yet responds to Mikhail's journal with compassion: rather than burn it, she recognizes that it may explain why his daughters were sent away. Her loyalty is outspoken and practical, and she rebukes her sister when she thinks their people are being led toward ruin.

Prospector Gann is an Explorers' League prospector captured with Raegar's team while they searched Dun Argol for artifacts and its history. After being freed, he urges you to rescue the other prospectors still held on the tiers above. His thanks quickly gives way to concern for his companions, who remain in danger.

Prospector Torgan is an Explorers’ League member captured with Raegar’s team at Dun Argol. Held by the iron dwarves, he fears they may force him to fight in their war against the stone giants. His relief at being freed makes clear he wants no part in that conflict.

Prospector Varana is an Explorers’ League member captured with Raegar’s team at Dun Argol. She has been listening to the iron dwarves: they speak of serving their master Loken, though she observes that only a few seem to receive orders from him. Her account distinguishes their broad allegiance from who is actually directed by Loken.
An Amberpine Scout is a field scout encountered around Amberpine and the surrounding Grizzly Hills.
A Conquest Hold raider who relies on demoralizing shouts, interception, and hard strikes when fighting.

Raider Captain Kronn directs the campaign against Alliance forces at Blackriver Logging Camp, treating the logging operation as a source of supplies for the Horde’s push toward Icecrown. He urges attacks on the Alliance and celebrates each gain as progress toward victory, while acknowledging that control of the camp is not yet complete. His words express the campaign’s aim, not a confirmed outcome.

Barracks Master Rhekku is an innkeeper at the barracks, with bunks in the back for travelers. His brisk, practical welcome warns visitors not to make trouble and notes that the nights can be bitterly cold even without falling snow.
Camp Oneqwah Brave is an elite fighter at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills. It uses Cleave against nearby targets and can enrage when badly wounded.
Grizzly Bears roam the Grizzly Hills area. These level 73–74 beasts have an out-of-combat script and can be interacted with through a spell-click action.
Sani'i is the Trade Goods vendor in the Grizzly Hills settlement at area 4206. Speak with this named trader to browse goods.
Seer Yagnar serves as the Poison & Reagents vendor in the Grizzly Hills settlement at area 4206, specializing in those supplies.
Smith Prigka is the settlement's armorer in Grizzly Hills. This named smith offers goods and repair service.
Iron Rune Overseers are level 74–75 figures stationed in area 4220 of Grizzly Hills. Their combat movement is disabled while out of combat.
Captain Bonemaw is a humanoid captain in Grizzly Hills.

Tormak the Scarred is the Taunka chieftain of Camp Oneqwah, directing the camp’s effort against the iron dwarves at Dun Argol. He treats a wounded dwarf as a possible source of intelligence, but requires the fever to be brought down and offers safety if the dwarf joins their common fight. Practical and pressed for time, he acknowledges Prospector Rokar’s golem plan when it succeeds, then says Rokar is of no further use to them.

An Explorers' League prospector, Rokar is working under Tormak's pressure to assemble a war golem. He understands that its parts and power cells must be prepared before it can fight, and worries about the consequences of delay. His reactions show fear and confusion under pressure; he also firmly refuses to help capture Brann.
A silver-coated stag found across several parts of the surrounding region.
A Dragonflayer flamebinder, a hostile humanoid combatant of the clan.

A Dragonflayer huscarl serving Thane Torvald Eriksson's forces at Voldrune. The clan was preparing for war, and both Alliance and Horde leaders sought to weaken its ranks before it could threaten their settlements.

Windseer Grayhorn reads the land’s distress in the corruption of Vordrassil and studies tainted samples and energy to learn how to heal it. He seeks Tur Ragepaw’s aid in saving Ursoc’s spirit, while also binding his sight to imperial eagles to scout Alliance movements.
Sergeant Thurkin directs people to Samir for the work called Good Troll Hunting.

Orsonn is a son of Ursoc who remembers roaming the Grizzly Hills while his father ruled there. He says he is now doomed to spend the rest of his life in a cave. Local leaders seek his account of whether the corruption affecting the furbolg has reached Ursoc’s offspring.

Kodian is a daughter of Ursoc who watches over a once-sacred shrine. She says she has not seen a stranger there in a long time. Leaders investigating the corruption among the furbolg seek her account of whether Ursoc’s children have been affected.

Master Woodsman Anderhol helps direct Amberpine Lodge's response after a Horde raid leaves its storehouse short of food. He calls for hunters to replenish supplies and address competition from local worgs, while helping counter Horde scouting through eagle vision. His exchange with Benjamin Jacobs points to a familiar working routine around retrieving amberseeds.

Flamebringer is Thane Torvald Eriksson’s favored proto-drake, described as ferocious and temperamental. It is kept in chains in western Voldrune. Flame-imbued talismans are said to offer a way to control the unruly mount and turn it against the thane.
The Amberpine Woodsmen are local humanoid woodsmen associated with Amberpine in the Grizzly Hills.

Hierophant Thayreen is a druid at Amberpine Lodge who studies the corruption around Vordrassil and its effects on nearby furbolgs. He sees the taint as unnatural and dangerous, and works to understand it so the land can be healed. The work has taken a visible toll on him.

Tur Ragepaw is a furbolg who came north to learn about his relatives and found tribes at war, contrary to their nature. He has lost hope after seeing Ursoc tainted, but still fights to save him. He offers to protect the player and their allies, and calls Ursoc brother of Ursol and guardian of the furbolg tribes.
A broken-down mechanical Shredder in Grizzly Hills, configured as a vehicle.

Synipus is a questgiver at Blue Sky Logging Grounds who needs broken-down shredders repaired for Venture Bay. He sends the player to recover them and sees the refurbished machines as a possible way to shift the Alliance's fortunes. His brisk, work-focused manner leaves little room for chit-chat.

Thane Torvald Eriksson is the Dragonflayer leader at Voldrune, where he prepares for war with his huscarls. His favorite mount is Flamebringer, a proto-drake kept chained at the settlement; the talismans made by his flamebinders are intended to let an attacker control it against him.

Sergeant Nazgrim is a Horde officer at Conquest Hold, directing efforts against the Dragonflayers of Voldrune while the Horde faces the Alliance elsewhere. He treats the vrykul as a threat that must be removed before they can endanger the Horde, and calls on a Horde member to prove their strength. In a conditional greeting, he wonders whether Krenna doubts him and hopes joint action will prove their worth to the conqueror.

Woodsman Drake is an Alliance woodsman at Amberpine Lodge, concerned that Voldrune's preparations could leave the lodge vulnerable while its fighters are away. He urges action against the Dragonflayer huscarls and looks forward to seeing their thane face the loss of his proto-drake.
A Duskhowl Prowler is a beast found across several parts of Northrend's Grizzly Hills. It attacks with a gore.
Gordun offers Alliance visitors a ride to Venture Bay and urges them to attack Horde forces. Choosing his travel option starts the Alliance log ride.

Pipthwack is repairing a shredder at Blue Sky Logging Grounds. He calls its condition a mess, criticizes goblin engineering, and asks for replacement cogs, sprockets, and springs to get it working for the fight.
The Fern Feeder Moth is a moth found in the Grizzly Hills. Its name identifies its association with ferns.

Lurz is a shredder repairer at Blue Sky Logging Grounds, working under a quota he thinks was set by people who never had to repair the machines. He offers to share his commission for help finding replacement cogs, sprockets, and springs.

Grekk is a Horde commander at Blue Sky Logging Grounds who wants Alliance-held shredders captured and refurbished for use against the Alliance. He addresses the listener as a soldier and demands the machines for the Horde's campaign.
A Conquest Hold marauder, among the fighters Sergei identifies as targets in Silverbrook's conflict with the Horde.
Darrok is a travel contact for Venture Bay. His greeting asks whether you want him to send you there, and the travel option starts a Horde log ride.

Commander Bargok is fighting for the Horde at Blue Sky Logging Ground amid heavy losses. He has requested reinforcements, but much of his force is tied up at Venture Bay. He insists on holding the ground for the region's value to the Horde's Northrend campaign and urges pressure on the Alliance until help arrives.
A Conquest Hold skirmisher, a close-quarters fighter whose combat behavior includes a cleaving attack.
A skirmisher's corpse in Grizzly Hills.
Flora is a named creature in the Grizzly Hills area.
Thudder is a named creature in the Grizzly Hills area.
Mother of Bambina is a creature whose name identifies her as Bambina’s mother.
Bambina is a creature who cries, “NOOOOO! Mother! We’ll avenge you!” She becomes passive just after being summoned.
The Wounded Skirmisher is a wounded humanoid who thanks the player after receiving help, saying, “Ahh.... better,” “Whoa - I nearly died there. Thank you!” or “Thank you.”

Aumana is an overwhelmed healer at Blue Sky Logging Grounds, tending soldiers wounded in the fighting. She fears that the many casualties could drive the Alliance from Grizzly Hills and urgently asks for help treating the wounded. Her plea and thanks show how much she values each life saved.

Sergeant Hartsman is an Alliance officer at Blue Sky Logging Grounds, where many soldiers lie dead or dying. With much of the Alliance force committed to Venture Bay, he urges the remaining troops to strike the Horde and avenge their fallen comrades. He warns that even a successful attack may buy only a little time.

Ivan is a trapper at Aspen Grove Post whose cooperation matters to the Alliance effort in Grizzly Hills. After the other side keeps its bargain, he says his people will honor their deal. The arrangement aims to recruit local woodsmen as scouts for the king’s army.
A Conquest Hold grunt is a rank-and-file fighter who confronts enemies directly. In battle, the grunt uses Demoralizing Shout, closes in with Heroic Strike, and charges targets with Intercept.
A Westfall Brigade infantryman is a foot soldier serving in the brigade. These troops are present around Blue Sky Logging Grounds and elsewhere in Grizzly Hills.
A wounded Westfall infantry soldier, he speaks with relief to a helper, saying he nearly died and crediting that aid with giving him new life.

Rheanna is a healer at Blue Sky Logging Grounds. She says the fighting with the Horde is unusually brutal and that the wounded are too numerous for her to rescue alone, so she has prepared special bandages to let others help.

Sergei at Silverbrook welcomes a pact against the Horde and urges visitors to hunt Conquest Hold marauders, whom he calls “filthy animals.” He tests a visitor’s courage by sending them after Bonesnap and handing over a skinning knife for the task.

The marauders attacking Silverbrook answer to Sergeant Bonesnap, whom Sergei sends the player to find for a test of courage involving a skinning knife. Bonesnap fights with Demoralizing Shout and Intercept.

Barblefink is a Venture Bay mechanic whose shredder is out of commission. He seeks Element 115 from the Venture Company barge as solvent for lubricant-clogged gears, and offers a reward for it. His greeting is folksy and directs anyone seeking a rideable shredder into the hills.
A refurbished mechanical Shredder in Grizzly Hills, configured as a vehicle.

Sasha is a captured trapper who distrusts the people she once called her own. She warns that their test is meant to draw the player into becoming like them and urges caution. She says monsters killed her father and took her sister, and she wants to avoid trouble while she deals with that loss.
The Caged Prisoner is a frightened Alliance captive held in Silverbrook. On being approached, the prisoner pleads not to be killed; a rescue quest can free an Alliance Scout from the cage.
Conquest Hold Berserkers are numerous combatants found around Conquest Hold and nearby Venture Bay. Their combat routine includes Flurry.
Westfall Brigade Marines are combatants found around Conquest Hold and nearby Venture Bay. They begin attacking while out of combat.
Captain Brightwater commands troops from an Alliance destroyer at Venture Bay. The Horde's account of the fighting says Brightwater anticipates each advance, and calls for the captain's defeat.

Captain Zorna commands the Horde forces in Venture Bay's port and is positioned near a ship on the far side of the bay. The Alliance's account calls Zorna a fierce fighter and urges an attack on the port commander.
Baron Freeman leads the Westfall Brigade at Venture Bay. He offers a campaign against Captain Zorna and says that, if Zorna is defeated, he will order his men forward.

General Khazgar directs the Horde campaign at Venture Bay. He calls for Captain Brightwater's defeat, warns that the fight may take several allies or a repaired shredder, and says a soldier's bravery will inspire his men.
Katja of Silverbrook asks for help uprooting wolfsbane, which she fears will damage the village's crops. She nervously asks whether any of the plant got on you and mentions her allergies.

Silverbrook Hunters are local trappers at Forest's Edge Post. Conqueror Krenna identifies them as seeking to join the Alliance and orders the Horde to kill them before they can do so; the campaign also names their leader, Vladek.

The Silverbrook Hunters are trappers seeking Alliance ties and are also said to be blockading a road. Their leader, Vladek, is targeted by both Conquest Hold and Lieutenant Dumont; these accounts reveal little about his own motives.
An elite soldier of the Westfall Brigade, this combatant represents the unit’s field strength in Grizzly Hills.
A champion of Conquest Hold, this combatant stands among the hold’s elite fighters in Grizzly Hills.
An injured Drakkari refugee, displaced from home and left vulnerable by their wounds.
A Drakkari witch doctor who uses Voodoo Doll magic in combat.

Lieutenant Stuart of the Westfall Brigade directs a defense of Venture Bay, whose port he calls essential to Alliance operations. He says Captain Stoutmantle has taken the rest of the Brigade east to seek a passage through the mountains, leaving no reinforcements; Stuart calls for fighters against Conquest Hold’s assault and asks for a report on the fighting.

Centurion Kaggrum serves the Horde at Venture Bay, where he directs the campaign against the Westfall Brigade. He sends the player to kill Alliance forces as part of the effort to seize the port, and expects a report when the task is complete.

Gurtor works on machinery at the Horde base in Venture Bay. He asks for Element 115 from the Venture Company barge because its fuel works as solvent for cleaning lubricant from jammed gears, and offers a reward for a canister. He also warns that the shredder he has is out of commission; a rideable one can be found in the hills to the north.

A Venture Company straggler has lost confidence in the fight and wants to flee. Its shouted remarks are panicked: it fears the group will die, says it must get away, and complains that it never signed up for this.

Goremaw is a powerful creature counted among Arugal's lieutenants on Bloodmoon Isle. Sasha identifies Goremaw as one of the targets in her plan to strike Arugal's forces before confronting Arugal himself. In combat, Goremaw uses carnivorous and infected worgen bites.

Varlam, known as the Hand of Arugal, is one of Arugal's lieutenants on Bloodmoon Isle. Sasha includes Varlam among the targets in her plan to strike Arugal's forces before confronting Arugal himself. Varlam fights with cleave and Mortal Strike.

Selas is one of Arugal's lieutenants on Bloodmoon Isle. Sasha includes Selas among the targets in her plan to strike Arugal's forces before confronting Arugal himself. Selas uses an axe volley and can enter a killing rage when badly hurt.

Ruuna the Blind is a clairvoyant who says she received visions on the day she lost her eyesight. She prefers looking into the past, believing it often offers more useful knowledge than scrying the future. She warns that her answers may be unwelcome, and guides visitors through a vision connected to events they need to witness. Ruuna also says Sasha received the same vision and directs visitors to speak with her.

Private Arun has overheard the player speaking with a captain and cautions that matters in Northrend are not simple: the dead may remain relevant. He points the player toward Ruuna the Blind, whom people say speaks with the dead and sees the past and future, as a possible source of insight.
This rocket-propelled warhead serves as a vehicle. When a passenger boards, it casts Vehicle: Warhead Fuse.

Sergeant Downey of the Westfall Brigade directs a campaign at Venture Bay. He wants Venture Company stragglers driven from their buildings so his men can concentrate on fighting the Horde, and gives the player a smoke bomb for the task. He checks whether the work is finished and praises a successful effort.
Stone Guard Ragetotem is a Horde guard at the port who asks for Venture Company stragglers to be smoked out of their buildings, so the warriors can focus on fighting the Alliance.
A slain Drakkari humanoid whose remains can yield a Super Mana Potion.
Scourge Deathspeakers are Scourge spellcasters found in the Drak'Tharon area; they cast a Fire Beam while out of combat.
River Threshers are aquatic animals found in the rivers of the Drak'Tharon area.
Tatjana's Horse is a horse associated with Tatjana. On spawning, it removes the aura named “Mount Tatjana's Horse.”
Bubb Lazarr is a curious observer near the port who asks a visitor whether they have seen something lingering near the water's surface, then suggests it may be an iceberg.
Anya is Sasha’s frightened younger sister, held by the worgen-men after they took her father. She fears being eaten or changed into one of them, and pleads not to be left alone again.
The Silverbrook Defenders are the former trappers whom Conqueror Krenna describes as an uncertain threat to the Horde. She orders her forces to crush them, and this defender fights with Rend.

General Gorlok is a Horde general who orders the Alliance lumber shipment destroyed because the Horde cannot seize its resources. He is openly contemptuous of the Alliance and celebrates denying them control.

Grennix Shivwiggle promotes fights at the Conquest Pit, announcing each matchup to draw a crowd. He presents the contests with showman's flair, from bear and furbolg bouts to a lightning-powered iron golem, and openly treats the spectacle as a way to make coin.

Bookie Vel'jen handles the Conquest Pit's fight business with an eye on the betting. He praises a fighter's moves, tracks the odds, and celebrates when wagers against them pay off; his easygoing remarks call the combatant "friend" and sometimes end with "mon."

Gorgonna challenges Krenna's judgment, warning that Krenna could lead their people into ruin. She calls Krenna her sister; her lines about the pit's final confrontation pair the claim that her people are free of a tyrant with grief over her lost sister, and she asks to be alone.
Purkom is a Venture Coin vendor in the Grizzly Hills, offering goods to browse.
A humanoid combatant known as a Conquest Hold Defender, it uses Heroic Strike against nearby targets.
A Westfall Brigade defender in Grizzly Hills.

Commander Howser directs the Alliance effort against the Horde in Venture Bay, where he sees control of lumber as part of the struggle for resources and tactical advantage. He asks for an attack on the Horde lumber ship using fuel and a dockside torpedo, then welcomes the survivor and praises the strike. His orders and remarks show a practical, encouraging commander focused on denying the Horde supplies.
“Grizzly” D. Adams is a Venture Coin vendor with goods available to browse.

Scout Captain Carter is a field leader concerned with control of the logging sites around Venture Bay. He calls Blackriver the smallest camp but still considers it worth defending, since the Horde could turn its lumber into weapons. He directs the player to drive Horde forces from the camp and responds warmly to a successful effort, while urging others to join the fight.
A Venture Co. Evacuee is identified with the Venture Company and as someone displaced. Its combat behavior includes a Quick Feet spell.
A Drakkari Plague Spreader is a Drakkari creature associated with spreading plague. Its combat behavior includes the Plague Infected spell.
Johan is a beast found in Grizzly Hills.

Magistrix Phaelista is a Kirin Tor representative who guides travelers toward Dalaran. She explains that the city moved to Northrend and identifies Archmage Celindra at the Violet Gate as the recipient of her signet.

Magistrix Haelenai is a Kirin Tor representative who guides travelers toward Dalaran. She explains that the city moved to Northrend and identifies Archmage Celindra at the Violet Gate as the recipient of her signet.
Jesse Masters is a butcher whose work in Dalaran depends on local supplies. His shop dialogue describes depleted storehouses and a return to cooking after supplies are replenished.
Tim Street is a stable master.
Kor is a stable master.
Jason Riggins is listed as a Blacksmithing Supplies vendor. He offers goods for browsing and repairs.
Koloth supplies blacksmithing goods and offers repairs.
A humanoid Aspen Grove Trapper in Grizzly Hills.
Aspen Grove Trader is a Trade Goods vendor.
Aspen Grove Supplier is a vendor at Aspen Grove, offering food and drink.
Datalore Smallsphere is a vendor at Aspen Grove dealing in trade goods.
A Westfall Brigade scout in Northrend.
A humanoid Camp Winterhoof Wayfarer in Grizzly Hills.
A humanoid Ashwood Trapper.
A serpent combatant called a Serpent Defender, it uses Tail Lash against nearby targets and appears in more than one area.
Craga Ironsting is a stable master who offers to stable pets and help recover lost companions.

Elder Beldak speaks of the bright moon and new year as the time when the ancients awake. Beldak welcomes those who pay homage to the olden races, offers a token of goodwill and receives inquiries about fellow elders Lunaro, Whurain, Killas and Tauros.

Elder Lunaro recalls a people who once lived for the hunt, seeking glory and honor, and wonders whether the present is so different. Lunaro accepts a young visitor’s homage and offers a token in return. Visitors can also ask about elders Jarten, Chogan’gada, Skywarden and Beldak.

Elder Whurain recalls a people who lived for the hunt, seeking glory and honor, and asks whether the present is so different. Whurain accepts a young visitor’s homage and offers a token in return. Visitors can ask about elders Jarten, Chogan’gada, Lunaro and Beldak.
A small wild skunk found in Grizzly Hills.
Grocklar is a rare elite humanoid found in Grizzly Hills. In combat, Grocklar uses Stone Stomp and Stone Fist.
Seething Hate is an elite entity found in Grizzly Hills. It casts Seething Evil when attacked.
Syreian the Bonecarver is a rare elite in Grizzly Hills who fights with ranged attacks, including Shoot and Frost Arrow.
The Grizzly Hills Flame Warden tends the Alliance festival flame and explains that Alliance settlements keep festival fires. The Warden encourages honoring those fires and desecrating Horde fires.
The Grizzly Hills Flame Keeper tends the Horde festival flame and explains that Horde settlements keep festival fires. The Keeper encourages honoring those fires and desecrating Alliance fires.
A lake frog found around the shores and waters of Grizzly Hills.
A lake frog who speaks as a woman and says she has escaped a terrible curse. Her gratitude suggests relief at being free.
Arcturis is a named elite beast found in Grizzly Hills.

place_records.text: You are in Grizzly Hills, a contested land in Northrend where both the Alliance and the Horde hold settlements. The Alliance keeps the Westfall Brigade Encampment and Amberpine Lodge, and the Horde holds Conquest Hold and Camp Oneqwah. Scourge trolls haunt the ground, dragonflayers hold Voldrune, and iron dwarf constructs fight around Thor Modan.
You are in Grizzlemaw, a wild part of Grizzly Hills. Frostpaw warriors and shamans and Redfang hunters and elders roam it, and Imperial Eagles soar overhead.

You are in Westfall Brigade Encampment, an Alliance camp in Grizzly Hills. Captain Gryan Stoutmantle commands the Westfall Brigade here, holding ground between the Horde to the west and iron dwarves to the east. Explorers' League surveyor Brugar Stoneshear pulled his men out of Thor Modan when fighting made digging impossible, and Torthen Deepdig keeps the runic plates and Brann Bronzebeard's journal.

You are in Silverbrook, a village in Grizzly Hills. Sergei urges visitors to hunt Conquest Hold marauders as part of a pact against the Horde. Trappers and villagers have turned on each other here, and Envoy Ducal is trying to negotiate with the trappers.
You are in Vordrassil's Heart, a corrupted area of Grizzly Hills named for Vordrassil. Entropic oozes and Saronite horrors lurk here.
You are in Vordrassil's Tears, a corrupted area of Grizzly Hills named for Vordrassil. Entropic oozes lurk here.
You are in Vordrassil's Limb, a corrupted area of Grizzly Hills named for Vordrassil. Entropic oozes lurk here, and Imperial Eagles soar overhead.

You are in Amberpine Lodge, an Alliance camp in Grizzly Hills. Lieutenant Dumont directs the push through the land and wants routes and a passage toward Zul'Drak. A Horde raid left its storehouse short of food, and Master Woodsman Anderhol is calling for hunters to restock it.

You are in Solstice Village, in Grizzly Hills. Worgen-men took a girl's father and hold her younger sister Anya here; she fears being eaten or changed. Wolfcult initiates and Duskhowl prowlers haunt the village.

You are in Conquest Hold, a Horde settlement in Grizzly Hills where Conqueror Krenna is determined to crush the Alliance. Sergeant Nazgrim directs the campaign against the Dragonflayers of Voldrune, and Grennix Shivwiggle promotes bouts at the Conquest Pit.

You are in Voldrune, a Dragonflayer holding in Grizzly Hills where Thane Torvald Eriksson rules. Dragonflayer flamebinders and huscarls fight here, and a ferocious proto-drake called Flamebringer is kept in chains in the western part.

You are in Granite Springs, a camp in Grizzly Hills where captured trolls are sold. Samir directs hunters to its live ice troll bounty, where Budd mingles with local trolls to trap them. Drakuru, a troll held in a cage here, claims to know things about the ruins, and Prigmon handles the dead trolls from the surrounding ruins.

You are in Zeb'Halak, a Drakkari area in Grizzly Hills where diseased Drakkari, Scourge deathspeakers and corpserenders are found. An image of Drakuru speaks here through the Eye of the Prophets, directing people to recover artifacts.

You are in Camp Oneqwah, a Horde camp in Grizzly Hills. Tormak the Scarred, a Taunka chieftain, directs the camp's fight against the iron dwarves at Dun Argol to the southeast, and Sage Paluna investigates Brann Bronzebeard's journal. Travellers find an inn, a stable and a wind rider master here.

You are in Eastwind Shore, a stretch of Grizzly Hills with no settlement of either side. Duskhowl Prowlers, Drakkari Protectors, Iron Rune-Weavers and Runed Giants roam here, and Syreian the Bonecarver is one of the foes.

You are in Boulder Hills, a battleground in Grizzly Hills. Kurun, a stone giant commander, directs the giants and Earthen here against the iron dwarves at Thor Modan. Iron Rune-Shapers and Rune Reavers are the main dangers, and many of the Grizzly Hills giants fighting here were enthralled by the iron dwarves' runes.

You are in Rage Fang Shrine, a place in Grizzly Hills. Orsonn, a son of Ursoc, lives here and says he is doomed to spend the rest of his life in a cave, and local leaders want his account of the corruption among the furbolg. Frostpaw Warriors and Frostpaw Shamans are the dangers here.

You are in Drakil'jin Ruins, a Drakkari ruin in Grizzly Hills. Ancient Drakkari fighters here sound weary and long for endless sleep, and an image of Drakuru promises to cleanse Drak'Tharon Keep. Drakkari Protectors, Drakkari Oracles and a Guardian Serpent are the dangers.
You are in Heart's Blood Shrine, a site in Grizzly Hills. Redfang Hunters and Redfang Elders are the main dangers here, along with Grumbald One-Eye and a Frosthorn Ram.

You are in Dun Argol, an iron dwarf stronghold in Grizzly Hills. Iron Thane Furyhammer leads it, rune-smiths there build war golems, and lightning sentries guard its edges. Explorers' League prospectors taken here are still held on its upper tiers.

You are in Thor Modan, the old iron dwarf capital in Grizzly Hills. Stone giants and Earthen are besieging it, and the iron dwarves' constructs fight them around its walls. Runic Battle Golems and Rune Reavers are the main dangers, and Forgemaster Damrath is among the foes.

You are in Blue Sky Logging Grounds, a contested camp in Grizzly Hills where Alliance and Horde troops fight over the sawmill. Commander Bargok holds the ground for the Horde amid heavy losses, and Sergeant Hartsman leads the Alliance troops, with much of each side's force committed to Venture Bay. Healers Aumana and Rheanna tend the wounded, and repairers work on broken shredders here.

You are in Prospector's Point, a place in Grizzly Hills where Alliance explorers work. Raegar Breakbrow, an Explorers' League researcher, plans to assemble and power a war golem from parts taken at Dun Argol to hinder the iron dwarves, and Mountaineer Kilian directs a rescue of the prospectors held at Dun Argol.

You are in Redwood Trading Post, a trading post in Grizzly Hills. Its merchant Hugh Glass knows about Loken and the iron dwarves, and he keeps a picky pet, Griselda, who favors fish from the Eastwind Shore.

You are in Heartwood Trading Post, a neutral post in Grizzly Hills. A young girl named Emily, whose brother Walter is a squire with the Westfall Brigade, has wandered lost into the woods with her pet rabbit, Mr. Floppy. She is frightened and worried for him.

You are in White Pine Trading Post, a neutral post in Grizzly Hills. Sasha hunts the wolfcult, which took her sister, and the curse it spreads is turning the people of Silverbrook and Solstice Village into beasts. Her father is dead, and her anger is fierce. Anatoly, who taunts her, knows where a prisoner is held in a wolf den.

You are in Aspen Grove Post, an Alliance post in Grizzly Hills. Its traders sell trade goods and food and drink. The trapper Ivan has made a deal with Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge to bring local woodsmen in as scouts for the Alliance effort, and he says his people will honor it.
You are in Forest's Edge Post in Grizzly Hills, where a number of Silverbrook hunters roam. Vladek is also among its dangers.

You are in Venture Bay, a contested port in Grizzly Hills. Baron Freeman leads the Westfall Brigade here and General Khazgar directs the Horde, and each side fights for the port. Captain Zorna leads the Horde in the port, while Captain Brightwater commands from an Alliance destroyer in the bay. Venture Company stragglers still hold buildings around it.

You are in Bloodmoon Isle, an island just off the coast of Grizzly Hills. Bloodmoon worgen and cultists roam it, and the lieutenants Varlam and Selas, who serve Arugal, are among its dangers. Sasha, who hunts the wolfcult, is found here as well.

You are in Shadowfang Tower in Grizzly Hills. Bloodmoon cultists and worgen gather here, and the Shade of Arugal and Goremaw are among its dangers. Sasha, who hunts the wolfcult, is found here as well.

You are in The Conquest Pit, the fighting pit at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills, which the Horde holds. Spectators crowd around to watch the fights. Provisioner Lorkran sells general goods and complains that Krenna dictates what the hold buys and sells.

You are in Ruins of Tethys in Grizzly Hills. The stone giant Gavrock is here, trying to free his bound brothers from the iron dwarves. He names Loken as the dwarves' commander and says Loken plans to exterminate the stone giants.

You are in Silverbrook Hills, a contested area of Grizzly Hills. Horde marauders from Conquest Hold clash here with the Silverbrook Defenders, former trappers who fight for the Alliance. Conqueror Krenna calls the defenders an uncertain threat and orders them crushed.

You are in Ruins of Drak'Zin in Grizzly Hills. Drakkari shamans, warriors and ice serpents attack travelers here. Drakuru speaks through a summoned image, asking for help recovering artifacts tied to the defenses of Drak'Tharon Keep so the keep can be cleansed of the undead.

You are in Harkor's Camp, a dwarven camp near Drakil'jin in Grizzly Hills. Harkor, a dwarf waiting on an associate, is bitter toward trolls after they captured him. Kraz, who listens for spirits, says many voices from the ruins seek peace. Duskhowl prowlers roam nearby.

You are in Ruuna's Camp, a camp in Grizzly Hills. Ruuna the Blind is a clairvoyant who lost her sight and prefers visions of the past to visions of the future. Once she has gossamer dust from the fern feeder moths to the northeast, she will brew a potion that carries people to past events.

You are in Drak'atal Passage, a passage in Grizzly Hills where drakkari defenders, serpent defenders, witch doctors and scourge corpserenders are the dangers. An image of Drakuru, summoned at a brazier, wants the Drakkari Tablets from the ruins of Drakil'jin to the east so he can read them. Imperial eagles soar overhead, and local investigators found the Horde binding its sight to them to spy on a camp.

You are in Ursoc's Den, a den in Grizzly Hills. Tur Ragepaw, a furbolg who came north to find his kin, found their tribes at war and has lost hope since Ursoc was tainted, though he still fights to save him. Undead miners and ursus maulers are the dangers here.
You are in The Forgotten Overlook, an overlook in Grizzly Hills. Frosthorn rams and iceshard elementals are the dangers here.

You are in Bonesnap's Camp, a Horde camp in Grizzly Hills. Marauders from Conquest Hold, who answer to Sergeant Bonesnap, are attacking Silverbrook, and a captured trapper named Sasha is held in the camp. She distrusts the people she once called her own and warns that they want to turn newcomers into one of them.
